parts.html: The K-09 standard model is a contemporary furniture composition in shades of gray that brings together the elegance of glass fronts, the expressive texture of natural stone, and the functionality of a kitchen island.
The straight layout organizes the main work zone along one wall, while a freestanding island expands the kitchen’s capabilities, providing additional surface for cooking and everyday tasks.

A distinctive feature of the K-09 model is the combination of glass upper fronts and painted lower cabinets. The glass visually lightens the furniture, creating an interesting contrast with the solid gray surfaces. This solution suits contemporary interiors in apartments, condos, and private homes.
The quartzite countertop complements the furniture composition with the natural texture of real stone. Paired with gray fronts, it creates an understated interior with expressive details.
The total length of the kitchen is 6.7 linear meters. The straight arrangement accommodates built-in appliances, work surfaces, and spacious storage systems.
A cargo pull-out adds extra functionality, making it easy to organize food and kitchen utensils.
The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard. Hettich hinges with soft-close mechanisms ensure smooth door closing, while AvanTech YOU Hettich drawers make the storage systems comfortable to use.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes modern custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-09 standard model can be adapted to the individual dimensions of your room, the specifics of the layout, and the requirements for built-in appliance placement. If needed, the cabinet configuration, storage systems, and kitchen island dimensions can be adjusted.
We offer comprehensive services for kitchen furniture design, material selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
To order the K-09 kitchen or get a personalized price quote, contact DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
